annual fee: the yearly cost of holding the card
interest rate: the ongoing APR charged on carried balances
intro apr: a promotional 0% or reduced APR for an introductory period
balance transfer fee: the cost of moving an existing balance onto the card
foreign transaction fee: a surcharge on purchases made abroad or in another currency
late fee: the penalty charged for a missed or late payment
rewards rate: the general base earn rate on ordinary spend - use only when the answer does not specify the reward form or category
cash back: rewards paid as cash or a statement credit
points earning: rewards earned as points or miles rather than cash
welcome bonus: a one-time signup or introductory bonus for new cardholders
spending categories: which categories earn elevated or bonus rewards
eligibility requirements: credit score, income, or approval criteria needed to qualify
travel perks: travel benefits such as credits, elite status, or trip insurance
rental car coverage: insurance or damage waiver for rental cars
purchase protection: coverage for damaged, lost, or stolen purchases
extended warranty: extension of a manufacturer warranty on purchases
fraud protection: security features and liability protection against fraudulent charges
issuer reputation: the standing or trustworthiness of the issuing bank or network
merchant acceptance: how widely the card is accepted by merchants
mobile app: the quality of the mobile app or digital account tools
customer service: the quality of support the cardholder receives
